notes.title: Hotfix 0.67.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779735/693217ca5328573aa6264536bf1f5a13e38b7934.png[/img]
HOTFIX 0.67.0

Guys, I got sick so I couldn't make progress on this update. But it's up now.

God of Stickfights servers went into a maintenance due to bugs with the multiplayer

Apparently there are times when the server was connecting to the wrong regions or not connecting properly

That's why in this hotfix I added:

- A way to confirm in which region you are connected.

- An internal double check that you are connected correctly to the server.

- Changed (again) the server config to be more fluid.

- 15 second timer on character selection.

- 10 second timer in the scenario selection.

------ gameplay changes -----

- Buff to gomu skin skill, now the movement speed is reduced only 11%.

Note:  for all those who are not on the discord, that the server is in maintenance does not mean that you can not play online, just that I am constantly experimenting and making changes to the server so that can cause strange things.

Lastly, I noticed that there are a lot of people here on steam that are not on discord, you should join, I've been pretty active, so if you have any comments I'll most likely read them and you have people to play with, a win-win!

[url=https://discord.gg/X5MjZxv9Za]Official GOS Discord[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.66.0
notes.notes:
[u]0.66.0[/u]

Hi, this update is not small, but I still classify it as a Hotfix because more than adding content it focuses on improving the game experience. 
I'm still working on the next big update, I'm working hard to make the next character awesome in every way.

Have fun :)

- Fixed bug with chat in online multiplayer that caused the caracther to still be moving sometimes

New input for chat " 1 " on keyboard

- Fixed bug that prevented some players from playing custom games correctly

If the message “Match not found” when joining custom games appears, click refresh

- UI reworked in some menus and GUI Improved
- Improved connection stability when using a gamepad in online games (Xbox, Playstation). 

This feature is still in testing, due to limitations I have not been able to test more controllers and in fact this game is not recommended to be played with a controller, but if you wish I guess you will now be able to use your controller

- The block mechanic have been completely changed based of player feedback and his animation re-worked

notes.title: Here comes a new challenger! (Big announcenment and Devlog)
notes.notes:
[b]"Azul the Dragon" is confirmed as the next character to arrive in the God of Stickfights arena![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779735/ecd267e7c08edc6488555de5575c978330261da0.png[/img]

Hello everyone! I'm very excited to announce the next character of God of Stickfights, "Azul the Dragon" this is one I've been working on for quite some time because it's a very important one, being part of the trio of main characters already planned.

Talking about his development I must say that his animation was very challenging as he has Wings (in his divine transformation) and uses a long distance yoyo in his normal form, so I had a hard time animating that.

I think his mechanics and abilities will not leave anyone indifferent as they are quite interesting, in the next days I will be uploading to my youtube channel a showcase or things related to this character :)

P.S: Even though the character is already planned you can still bring your suggestions and maybe I could add them, so if after watching the showcase there is something that you think would be good, you can tell it in the discord or comments.
The new character update should be available sometime around Valentine's Day.

----------------------------

[b]Azul the Dragon.[/b]

Main weapon: Yoyo. 

Divine transformation: Semi-Dragon form. 

His name is "Azul" and his nickname "The Dragon", he uses a yoyo as his main weapon, while as his name says he is the Dragon God, so in his divine transformation he obtains imposing wings with which he can move and attack around the stage with great freedom.

[b]His backstory:[/b]
He is the main rival of the God "Rojo the Wrath", since they met long ago on Mount Olympus,  have disputed countless fights and has not yet found a clear winner of these. All their friends in the Stick Pantheon are absolutely fed up with having to put up with their fights (and the destruction they cause along the way).

Azul is very intelligent and slightly calculating, but what stands out most about his personality is that he is totally unconcerned with life, he always acts without obligations and this is demonstrated by the way he handles the yoyo, his favorite weapon.

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hello, God of Stickfights has now finally entered Early access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779735/da6f0cfb0b0ce7bd7c37ae182115b7a6c3e92dbd.png[/img]

Despite being released today January 31 and having an itch version for a long time, it will still be in development, definitely the game has a lot of room for improvement and can become something much bigger with future updates.

But because it is a very demanding project, I took the decision to release it on Steam in order to continue working on future updates full time.

However, as a reward for all those who support the game during its early stages, the game price is reduced by 50% of the final price, its launch price is $4.99, as new updates are added this price will progressively go up to double the current price, $9.99.

In next posts I will be announcing the next updates, but if you want to follow the development more in depth join the official discord or watch my Youtube channel.

That's all, I hope you enjoy God of Stickfights! :) 
- Best regards, Darksoulx. 
(The game dev, not a secret sequel to the game saga you're thinking of).
